hero.headline: Your health story, always with you.
hero.intro: One secure, lifelong home for your medical records. Free for everyone, designed to make care more connected, understandable, and human.

mission.title: Healthcare should remember the whole person.
mission.everyoneText: No paywalls, targeted ads, or selling your health data.
mission.permissionText: You decide who sees what, for how long, and why.
mission.lifeText: A portable record that stays with you across every chapter.

demo.title: Try the tools, using sample data only.
demo.description: Nothing here connects to a real health record. These small demos show how LifeHealth ID could help you stay organized and prepared.
demo.notAdvice: For preparation only, not medical advice.

legal.reviewNote: Medical and legal copy requires qualified human review before release.
legal.notAdvice: This is educational information, not a diagnosis or medical advice.

footer.tagline: Free, nonprofit, and built for the long term.
